The apply_template returned a tuple of tuples? It shows a string representation: "(('C/...', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)". Likely the result is a list of tuples each containing precursor SMILES strings. So there is one outcome with two precursors: precursor1 = "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" and precursor2 = "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". Need to format as list of lists: [["precursor1", "precursor2"]].

But there may be other target SMILES (the other two variants). Should we also apply to them? The question: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl1-template_search-2 to the molecule below?" The molecule below likely the same as earlier (maybe the product). The earlier answer gave three possible SMILES (maybe due to stereochemistry). We might need to apply template to each of those three to get all possible precursor sets. Let's apply to the other two SMILES.
